edge_checks.note: the transform rule adds the origin header at the edge for every request to the host, so a request through Cloudflare never reaches the origin without it; the origin's own refusal (403) is read on the Ingress leg from the allowed developer address

ingress_origin_check.note: the 403 is the application's own refusal (the origin header check), not the ingress's allow-list refusal, which reads "RBAC: access denied"

allow_list_check.note: the ingress's own refusal: the allow-list (Cloudflare's published IPv4 ranges only) is in force again; the application is not reached
